name: agent-harness
description: Claude Code toolkit that automates repetitive developer tasks: git, PRs, tickets, planning, and knowledge management

base_branch.title: Base branch
base_branch.description: Branch that feature branches are created from and PRs target (e.g. main, staging)

project_tool.title: Project tool
project_tool.description: Ticket system: jira, linear, clickup, or github

project_key.title: Project key
project_key.description: Ticket prefix used in branch names and PR titles (e.g. PROJ). Leave blank if not applicable.

ci_command.title: Local CI command
ci_command.description: Command that mirrors hosted CI locally, run before creating a PR (e.g. scripts/ci-local.sh). Leave blank to skip.
